findings.statement: Nominal inverse-area scaling is a coarse recorded-channel resistance reference within these two wafers; it lowers held-die error relative to a constant but leaves large failure cases.
findings.applicability: 19 dies on two wafers. Unknown acquisition gain/offset, nominal rather than measured area. Tail fits operationally define a response and may include defective junctions; all unambiguous devices retained.
findings.limitations: All comparison models, unfavorable development folds and confirmation groups are retained; secondary model winners do not replace preselected reference.
findings.falsification: All comparison models, unfavorable development folds and confirmation groups are retained; secondary model winners do not replace preselected reference.
findings.prior_art: Source states data are already thoroughly analyzed in a submitted paper; record currently gives no accessible linked paper. Title search found corresponding2026 conference process abstract. Absolute junction-gain calibration remains unresolved. Inverse-area tunnel-conductance scaling is established physical prior, not a novelty claim.
findings.task_version_history: ASD5 frozen development selection and exposed confirmation
